proposed_from.topic: Weak-separation honest-inference frontier for exact close-comparison panels. With finitely many treated stacks and candidate donors, iid within-group micro-panels, and a joint asymptotically linear pre-equality-score/post-mean vector, define the nonempty close set by exact zero score and require every close donor to imply the same ATT. Construct simultaneous joint donor-label/ATT Gaussian inversion with within-label outcome uncertainty. Prove uniform coverage, oracle root-n diameter under fixed separation, and a matching positive local-minimax expected-diameter frontier over root-n-separated triangular arrays, including multiple-close-donor faces and shared-control covariance. Reanalyse the CMS State Innovation Models comparison-state claims workflow. PRESOLVE EVIDENCE REQUIRING VERIFICATION: Profiling each joint Wald ellipsoid yields an explicit labelwise interval centered at the post-effect estimate corrected by its score regression; a Gaussian maximum critical value makes the hull cover every true label simultaneously. On the unscaled weak-risk scale, post-mean noise vanishes and the problem reduces to a finite Gaussian label-confidence experiment on a union of coordinate hyperplanes. For two donors with identity score covariance, switches h=(0,c) and h=(c,0), effect gap Delta, and total-variation distance 2 Phi(c/sqrt(2))-1 force honest expected diameter at least Delta times [1-2 alpha-TV]_+; c=1, Delta=0.4, alpha=0.05 gives about 0.1518. Fixed separation eliminates false labels and restores the oracle root-n hull. UNRESOLVED BOTTLENECK: Prove uniform Le Cam minimax equivalence for the nonclosed triangular union and show that covariance-estimated simultaneous inversion attains the finite-Gaussian worst expected-diameter functional, including multiple-zero-label faces. EARLY KILL TEST: Solve the two-donor identity-covariance Gaussian decision problem over 0<c<=H analytically or by a fine-grid linear program and compare its exact minimax diameter with the proposed maximum-critical hull; a persistent sharpness gap not repairable within joint inversion should pivot or stop the run.

seed_list: S1: Decision-dual honest expected-diameter frontier on exact-zero donor faces.
S2: Feasible joint score-effect Gaussian hull with shared-control covariance.
S3: Uniform Le Cam transfer for root-sample donor-face arrays.
S5: Equivalence-margin sharp ATT sensitivity region.
S6: Conditional or hybrid inference for the active zero-score face.
S7: Conformal donor-label inversion under block exchangeability.
S10: Shared-group covariance decomposition and correction.

seed_details.anchor_read: Introduction; Section V.A on projection intervals; Proposition 3 on easy selection; Conclusion; compared with Theorem 1 and Corollary 1 of EvansHansenStark2005 and their acceptance-region proof.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace winner truncation by face-indexed coverage constraints and optimize overlap of acceptance regions by Gaussian likelihood ratios.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches for Gaussian confidence sets on unions of coordinate hyperplanes with minimax expected diameter found no closer theorem than restricted-location duality.
seed_details.red_team: Immediate from Evans, Hansen, and Stark by changing the restricted parameter space.
seed_details.rebuttal: Their parameter is a fixed location functional; here the reported ATT changes with the zero-coordinate face, and intersecting faces impose coherence constraints absent from their theorem.

seed_details.anchor_read: Methods overview and Appendix G.1, including Euclidean ranking, unstable Mahalanobis matching, top-three retention, claims-runout substitutions, and two-state Medicaid comparisons; method proof construction read in FermanPinto2019 and ChernozhukovChetverikovKato2013.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace the many-control empirical reference distribution by a joint CLT for within-group micro means and propagate the same primitive group covariance through every donor label.
seed_details.destination_search: Fixed-label micro-panel donor selection with shared-control Gaussian inversion did not appear in searches centered on few-treated difference-in-differences and synthetic-control inference.
seed_details.red_team: This is only a routine multivariate delta-method interval.
seed_details.rebuttal: The explicit profile, exact-zero union coverage, multiple-face uniformity, and reused-group covariance are not delivered by marginal delta-method intervals.

seed_details.anchor_read: Introduction; uniform asymptotic size theorem; strong-identification theorem; proof reduction to the Gaussian process; Conclusion; adjacent drifting-sequence construction read in AndrewsCheng2014.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Strengthen subsequence weak convergence to two-sided Markov-kernel approximation and add uniform integrability for unbounded diameter loss.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches combining Le Cam deficiency, union-of-faces parameters, exact-zero labels, and expected confidence-set diameter found no direct treatment.
seed_details.red_team: LAN for sample means makes the result automatic.
seed_details.rebuttal: Ordinary LAN does not uniformly transfer unbounded risk through a target map that changes discontinuously at multiple-zero faces.

seed_details.anchor_read: Introduction; component-estimator theorems; self-normalized statistic theorem; within-component dependence discussion; Conclusions and recommendations.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Derive the efficient influence function conditional on a known active donor face under micro-sample rather than time-series asymptotics.
seed_details.destination_search: Standard finite-dimensional mean-contrast efficiency results already cover the regular known-face submodel.
seed_details.red_team: The efficiency bound is the variance of a known linear contrast and is textbook.
seed_details.rebuttal: No nonregular gain survived once the face was treated as known.

seed_details.anchor_read: Introduction; equivalence null and alternative; asymptotic testing construction; implementation section; Conclusion; adjacent sensitivity construction read in RambachanRoth2023.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace a binary equivalence-test decision by projection of bounded post-trend violations across every margin-admissible donor.
seed_details.destination_search: Selected-set interval inference exists, but no source found jointly derives donor validity and sharp ATT endpoints from equivalence margins and cross-donor disagreement.
seed_details.red_team: Rambachan and Roth already give honest sensitivity intervals.
seed_details.rebuttal: Their comparison structure is fixed; the proposed endpoints vary jointly with a finite data-dependent donor set.
seed_details.decision: credible alternative, not selected because it changes the exact-equality target

seed_details.anchor_read: Conditional interval construction and hybrid projection discussion, with adjacent selective-inference framework in FithianSunTaylor2014.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Condition on a sufficient contrast for donor-face selection rather than the identity of an argmax winner.
seed_details.destination_search: Post-selection reviews cover sample splitting, simultaneous inference, and conditioning, but not exact zero-coordinate face selection with a common target on intersections.
seed_details.red_team: This is a direct conditional-inference relabeling.
seed_details.rebuttal: The selection event is measure-zero at the population level and the target map changes on intersections, so winner-polyhedron conditioning does not directly apply.
seed_details.decision: absorbed into S1 decision-dual open question

seed_details.anchor_read: Introduction and conclusion, together with the cited conformal counterfactual-inference construction.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Construct a block-permutation orbit that simultaneously exchanges donor scores and post contrasts.
seed_details.destination_search: The CMS micro-panel design supplies independent beneficiaries within states but not exchangeable state labels or time blocks.
seed_details.red_team: The required permutation symmetry is absent from the stated sampling model.
seed_details.rebuttal: No defensible exact symmetry was found without replacing the application.

seed_details.anchor_read: Introduction; Main Results 1--3 on Gaussian and multiplier approximations under arbitrary coordinate dependence; proof use of comparison and anti-concentration.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Let the candidate-label count diverge and control both the correlated maximum and the random union of label profiles.
seed_details.destination_search: High-dimensional maxima are settled, but searches found no theorem for exact-zero donor-face targets with growing label count.
seed_details.red_team: This follows by inserting the CCK critical value.
seed_details.rebuttal: Gaussian maxima control coverage only; the random face union and its diameter require additional separation and anti-concentration analysis.
seed_details.decision: credible, deferred because the CMS menu is fixed

seed_details.anchor_read: Appendix G.1 comparison-state ranking and replacement workflow.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Treat donor retention as a statistical decision minimizing downstream ATT interval diameter plus mismatch loss.
seed_details.destination_search: The application does not define a causal welfare value or intervention policy induced by donor choice.
seed_details.red_team: Donor selection is an inferential nuisance, not treatment-policy learning.
seed_details.rebuttal: The M16 object is not naturally supported by the target estimand.

seed_details.anchor_read: Heteroskedastic group-size model and feasible variance calibration; adjacent CMS reuse patterns and the CCK covariance-replacement argument.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Write marginal donor variances as an incomplete projection of the primitive group covariance and restore the omitted cross-label blocks.
seed_details.destination_search: Cluster and synthetic-control covariance papers do not characterize the exact fixed-label shared-group map used here.
seed_details.red_team: Stacking influence functions automatically gives the covariance matrix.
seed_details.rebuttal: The algebra is routine once posed, so it is valuable as an enabling lemma but not an independent kernel.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: Theorems 1–2
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: Exact donor validity and causal transport are assumed through the nonempty exact-close and shared-slope untreated-change conditions; diagnostics can challenge but cannot establish them from ranked sample balance.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: Uniform coverage and fixed-separation diameter recovery are conditional claims over the exact-close triangular-array class, not validation of the historical CMS workflow.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: Open-ended Question 2
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: Any transfer claim is restricted to a dominated QMD reduced-mean subexperiment with a common parameter map and a separate uniform-integrability condition for diameter loss.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: Only restricted reduced-experiment equivalence and risk transfer are in scope; unrestricted raw-data Le Cam equivalence is not claimed.

banked_reason: The advertised weak-separation panel frontier is not proved: its exact value uses a repaired score-only experiment with b observed noiselessly, while admissible panel effect contrasts vanish at O(n^-1/2).
banked_proposal_promise_gap: A faithful result would require a new sqrt(n)-scaled noisy local experiment, changing the risk scale, parameter space, least-favorable witnesses, attaining rule, and exact constant.
